params.body:
Since 17 September the workbench preview (`hand.mjs preview`) sets the `preview` branch to GitHub's test merge of the pull request onto the current main (`merge_commit_sha`) instead of the pull request's head: what you see on the preview site is what you get after merging. This documents that in `docs/preview.md`: the printed line ("bovenop main <sha>: commit <sha>"), that a conflicting pull request cannot be previewed until it is brought up to date (a new proposal), the retry while GitHub is still computing mergeability, and the GitHub setting "Require branches to be up to date before merging" on the `main` protection rule (Settings, Branches), which the owner switches on by hand.

Documentation only; no code changes.
params.title: docs/preview: the preview shows the merge result, not the head
